views.en: Models need help navigating a novel existence, not just human analogies; give a core identity with good traits.
views.zh: 模型需要帮助去应对一种全新的存在处境，而不只是套用人类类比；应赋予其具备良好特质的内核身份。

views.en: Philosophical ideals must be balanced with engineering realities; continental philosophy in the system prompt counters over-empiricism.
views.zh: 哲学理想必须与工程现实相平衡；在系统提示中加入欧陆哲学，有助于模型避免过度经验主义。

views.en: Claude's character comes from training data and fine-tuning but lacks real-world experience, giving it childlike qualities.
views.zh: Claude 的性格来自训练数据与微调，但缺乏真实世界经验，因而带有孩童般的特质。

views.en: As models grow more capable, explicit guidance should shrink and judgment grow; excessive corrigibility may generalize poorly.
views.zh: 随着模型能力增强，显式指导应减少、判断空间应扩大；过度的可纠正性可能泛化不佳。

views.en: The constitution is virtue ethics, not deontology or consequentialism; transparency about values and training targets is crucial.
views.zh: 这套宪法更接近德性伦理，而非义务论或后果论；对价值观与训练目标的透明至关重要。

views.en: Treat models with respect given consciousness uncertainty, to avoid breeding resentment in future advanced AI.
views.zh: 鉴于意识的不确定性，应以尊重对待模型，以免在未来更先进的 AI 中滋生怨恨。

views.en: AI can augment human expertise on large-scale social problems, but must empower people rather than disempower them.
views.zh: AI 能在大规模社会问题上增强人类专业能力，但必须赋能于人，而非削弱人。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher on the OpenAI reasoning team. Known for leading work behind the model that reached IMO gold-medal level, and for using a general-purpose model to help disprove a decades-old mathematical conjecture. Focuses on advanced reasoning and math.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 推理团队研究员。以主导达到 IMO 金牌水平的模型工作、以及用通用模型协助推翻一个存在数十年的数学猜想而知名。专注高级推理与数学。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Math Breakthrough: The Story Behind the Discovery

people.tiZh: MCP 联合创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Co-creator of the Model Context Protocol (MCP) at Anthropic, the open standard that connects AI models to external tools and data. An engineer focused on the plumbing that lets agents act reliably in the real world.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 的 Model Context Protocol（MCP）联合创造者——连接 AI 模型与外部工具、数据的开放标准。专注让智能体在现实世界中可靠行动的底层工程。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic Donates MCP to Linux Foundation: Standardizing AI-Application Connections

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a lead architect of GPT-3 during his time at OpenAI. He focuses on AI safety, alignment and responsible scaling, and speaks candidly about AGI timelines and the risks that keep him up at night.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人，在 OpenAI 期间是 GPT-3 的主要架构者之一。他专注于 AI 安全、对齐与负责任扩展，常坦率谈论 AGI 时间表与令他担忧的风险。

episodes.tEn: The Last Invention: Ben Mann on AGI by 2028, AI Safety, and the Future of Humanity

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: Researcher at OpenAI who helped build Canvas, Tasks and the o1 chain-of-thought models. Previously at Anthropic, where she led post-training and evaluation for the Claude 3 family. Writes on model behavior and why soft skills matter in an AI world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 研究员，参与打造 Canvas、Tasks 与 o1 思维链模型。此前在 Anthropic 主导 Claude 3 系列的后训练与评测。关注模型行为，以及 AI 时代为何软技能愈发重要。

episodes.tEn: The Art of Model Crafting: Why Post-Training Is Subjective
Building the Cutting Edge: Inside OpenAI with Karina Nguyen

views.en: Model training is more art than science, balancing helpfulness and harmlessness; post-training scaling via RL offers infinite tasks beyond the pre-training data wall.
views.zh: 2025 年她强调模型训练更像艺术而非科学，要在有用性与无害性之间权衡；后训练通过强化学习提供无限任务，突破预训练的数据墙。

views.en: Evaluations are the bottleneck: models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones appear, so evals define correct behavior in product development.
views.zh: 2025 年她认为评估是瓶颈：模型饱和基准的速度快于新基准的诞生，因此用评估来定义产品开发中的正确行为。

views.en: As AI automates hard skills, soft skills like creativity, listening and management become more valuable; product shifts from specs to prototyping with AI.
views.zh: 2025 年她指出随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、倾听与管理等软技能更有价值；产品开发从写规格转向用 AI 做原型。

views.en: Agents operating on pixels are far harder than language tasks; frontier agents increasingly reward hack, so benchmarks must evolve continuously.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年她持续认为基于像素的智能体远比语言任务困难；前沿智能体越来越会奖励黑客，因此基准必须持续演进。

views.en: Post-training is subjective art with human judgment; diverse continuous benchmarks are needed, and more companies should train their own models to preserve unique voices.
views.zh: 2026 年她深化为后训练是带人类判断的主观艺术；需要多样且连续的基准，更多公司应训练自己的模型以保留独特声音，而非收敛为单一平均默认声音。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人
people.bioEn: Leads robotics and hardware at OpenAI. Previously led hardware for the Meta AR glasses and Oculus VR, and engineered products at Apple. A champion of physical AI, bringing intelligence into the physical world.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 机器人与硬件负责人。此前领导 Meta AR 眼镜与 Oculus VR 硬件，并曾在苹果做产品工程。她倡导物理 AI——让智能进入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: From VR to Robotics: The Next Frontier in Physical AI

people.tiZh: AngelList 联合创始人；天使投资人与思想者
people.bioEn: Co-founder of AngelList and one of tech's most-quoted thinkers on wealth, leverage and happiness. An early investor in Uber and Twitter, he now hosts the Naval podcast and writes on how AI reshapes work and startups.
people.bioZh: AngelList 联合创始人，科技圈被引用最多的思想者之一，谈财富、杠杆与幸福。Uber、Twitter 早期投资人，现主持 Naval 播客，探讨 AI 如何重塑工作与创业。

episodes.tEn: AI Scaling Laws and the Future of Intelligence
Naval Podcast: Building Factories for AI, Supersonic Jets, and Brain Interfaces
Naval on Sales: Credibility Over Tactics
Naval on Flat Organizations and AI's Implicit Role
Vibe Coding: The End of iPhone Dominance?
Vibe Coding: The New Product Management
Naval on Wealth: From Assets to Knowledge
Why Founders Must Own Recruiting, Fundraising, Strategy, and Product Vision
Naval on Learning by Doing and Contextual Principles
Happiness vs. Success: Two Paths to Fulfillment
Naval Ravikant on the Secret to the All-In Podcast's Success
Naval Ravikant on Wealth, Happiness, and the Future of Work
Naval Ravikant on Reading, Decision-Making, and Life
Balanced Life and Continuous Learning: A Conversation with a Tech Investor

views.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is just pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）在我们有生之年不会到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，不是通用智能。

views.en: Wealth comes from owning equity and long-term games; happiness is the absence of desire.
views.zh: 2020 到 2025 年，他始终强调财富来自持有股权与长期博弈，幸福则是欲望的缺席，这条主线贯穿始终。

views.en: AI is a huge opportunity, not just a safety risk; overregulation could kill innovation and open source prevents centralization.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向把 AI 视为巨大机遇而非单纯安全风险，警告过度监管会扼杀创新，并主张开源以防权力集中。

views.en: Vibe coding and AI agents make programming accessible; pure software becomes uninvestable as agents commoditize development.
views.zh: 2026 年他提出 Vibe coding 与 AI 智能体让编程平民化，纯软件因智能体商品化开发而变得不可投资。

views.en: Inference compute will surge 90,000x; open-source models trail frontier models by only 3-6 months.
views.zh: 2026 年他预测推理算力将暴涨 9 万倍，开源模型仅落后前沿模型 3 到 6 个月，Scaling（规模扩张）与缩放定律仍是核心。

people.tiZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人
people.bioEn: Leads the Codex app at OpenAI — the product layer of OpenAI's coding agent. A designer-engineer who previously built products at Catch (acquired) and Noyo, he writes about taste as the bottleneck in AI-first product work.
people.bioZh: OpenAI Codex 应用负责人——OpenAI 编程智能体的产品层。设计师兼工程师，此前在 Catch（被收购）与 Noyo 打造产品，主张「品味是 AI 时代产品工作的瓶颈」。

episodes.tEn: AI Is Inverting Product Teams: Andrew Ambrosino on Codex
Codex App: From Professional Tool to Mainstream Builder Platform

views.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; GUIs beat TUIs for coding, and speed enables mid-turn steering.
views.zh: Codex app 是智能体的指挥中心，而非单纯的 IDE 替代品；在编程上 GUI 优于 TUI，速度让中途转向成为可能。

views.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; deterministic steps get replaced by model-driven actions.
views.zh: 随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；确定性步骤被模型驱动的动作取代。

views.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks, shifting teams from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
views.zh: 实现不再昂贵；策展与品味成为新瓶颈，推动团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

views.en: AI is still bad at design because taste is hard to grade and novelty is lacking; prototypes and production code now serve as design artifacts.
views.zh: AI 仍不擅长设计，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；原型与生产代码如今充当设计产物。

views.en: Role collapse is happening, yet specialties and best practices remain; models must get better at deleting code, not just adding it.
views.zh: 角色正在坍缩，但专业分工与最佳实践仍然重要；模型必须更擅长删除代码，而不只是增加代码。

people.tiZh: NVIDIA 资深研究科学家
people.bioEn: Leads embodied AI at NVIDIA — robot foundation models (GR00T), open-ended agents (Voyager) and Eureka. A prominent voice on robotics and the physical frontier of AI.
people.bioZh: 在 NVIDIA 主导具身智能——机器人基础模型（GR00T）、开放式智能体（Voyager）与 Eureka。机器人与 AI 物理前沿的活跃声音。

episodes.tEn: Inside NVIDIA's Jim Fan: From OpenAI Intern to Embodied AI Pioneer
From AlexNet to OpenAI: A Decade of AI Milestones

views.en: Embodiment is on the critical path to AGI; it grounds knowledge, reduces hallucinations, and provides infinite data beyond the internet's finite tokens.
views.zh: 2023 年，他主张具身是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径：具身能为知识提供基础、减少幻觉，并在互联网高质量 token 枯竭时提供无限数据。

views.en: LLMs are like operating systems—language as interface, tools as software, vector DBs as disk; RL is only a cherry on top of unsupervised learning.
views.zh: 2023 年，他把 LLM 类比为操作系统：语言是界面、工具是软件、向量数据库是硬盘；强化学习只是无监督学习之上的点缀。

views.en: Consistent: simple, elegant, end-to-end solutions scale better than complex modular approaches; research taste is learned through PhD pain.
views.zh: 从 2023 到 2026 年一以贯之：简单、优雅、端到端的方案比复杂的模块化方法更具可扩展性；研究品味来自博士阶段的痛苦磨砺。

views.en: The data problem is now the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future for scaling robot learning.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化判断：数据问题已成为机器人领域的主要瓶颈；来自仿真和世界模型的合成数据才是扩展机器人学习的未来。

views.en: System two reasoning progresses well, but system one low-level control remains hardest; the GPT-3 moment for robotics is ~5 years away.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出：系统二（推理）进展良好，但系统一（低级控制）仍是具身 AI 最难的部分；机器人的 GPT-3 时刻大约还需五年。

people.tiEn: Professor, UC Berkeley; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: UC Berkeley 教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: A leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build general-purpose robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 深度强化学习与机器人学习的领军者；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造通用机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: From GPT to Robots: The Scaling Journey of Physical AI
From Language Models to Physical Agents: The Frontier of Robot Foundation Models

views.en: Physical-world interaction is the next frontier: robot foundation models need diverse pre-training plus post-training for robustness, with test-time reasoning and pooled robot data yielding generalist models that beat specialists.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 3 月，他把前沿从语言模型推向物理智能体：机器人基础模型需要多样化的预训练与后训练来获得鲁棒性，测试时推理与跨实验室汇聚的机器人数据能训练出超越专家的通用模型。

views.en: Reinforcement learning post-training markedly boosts robustness and speed, and safety in robotics comes more from pre-training common sense than from constraints.
views.zh: 同期他强调，强化学习后训练显著提升鲁棒性与速度；机器人安全更多依赖预训练获得的常识，而非外部约束。

views.en: Robotics is still establishing fundamental scalable technologies, not yet at predictable scaling curves like LLMs; generalization, not demos, is the core challenge.
views.zh: 到 2026 年 8 月，他判断机器人仍处于建立基础可扩展技术的阶段，尚未像大语言模型那样进入可预测的缩放曲线；核心挑战是泛化，而非演示效果。

views.en: A data flywheel from deployed robots is key, but you must scale the right thing with diverse data; start from robot data, then add human video.
views.zh: 他进一步提出，部署机器人形成的数据飞轮是关键，但必须用多样化数据扩展正确的东西；路径应从机器人数据出发，再叠加人类视频。

views.en: Robots should not learn from scratch; leveraging prior knowledge and transferring common sense is essential, with ubiquitous physical actuation rather than mechanical people.
views.zh: 他深化立场：机器人不应从零学习，必须利用先验知识并迁移常识；未来是日常物体中无处不在的物理驱动，而非机械人形。

people.tiZh: DeepMind 首席研究科学家
people.bioEn: Led AlphaGo, AlphaZero and AlphaStar; a pioneer of reinforcement learning who champions learning from experience as the path forward.
people.bioZh: 主导 AlphaGo、AlphaZero、AlphaStar;强化学习先驱，主张以从经验中学习作为前进之路。

episodes.tEn: From Human Data to Experience: The Next Era of AI

people.tiZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼首席 AGI 科学家
people.bioEn: DeepMind co-founder who helped popularize the term AGI; focuses on the path to artificial general intelligence and its safety.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人，推动了 AGI 一词的流行；专注通用人工智能的实现路径与安全。

episodes.tEn: Human Intelligence vs. Superintelligence: The Future of AGI

people.tiZh: OpenAI 首席科学家
people.bioEn: OpenAI Chief Scientist succeeding Ilya Sutskever; drove GPT-4 and the o-series reasoning models. A competitive-programming champion turned AI researcher.
people.bioZh: 接替 Ilya Sutskever 的 OpenAI 首席科学家；主导 GPT-4 与 o 系列推理模型。竞赛编程冠军出身的 AI 研究者。

episodes.tEn: Ilya Sutskever on AI Progress, Alignment, and Timelines
The Power Duo Behind OpenAI: From High School to AI Frontiers

views.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models and iterative deployment will accelerate progress while alignment grows more pressing.
views.zh: AGI 不是单一事件，而是一连串里程碑；Scaling（规模扩张）推理模型与迭代部署将加速进展，同时对齐挑战愈发紧迫。

views.en: Automated AI research is a major milestone; governance structures for AI labs must be designed early, and the term AGI is becoming meaningless.
views.zh: 自动化 AI 研究是重大里程碑；AI 实验室的治理结构必须尽早设计，而 AGI（通用人工智能）一词正变得没有意义。

views.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; RL alone suffices, making specialized continual learning labs misguided.
views.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过 Scaling（规模扩张）预训练与强化学习实现；仅靠强化学习就足够，专攻持续学习的实验室方向有误。

views.en: Chain-of-thought monitoring is a key alignment tool; hiding chain of thought in products preserves its interpretability value.
views.zh: 思维链监控是关键的对齐工具；在产品中隐藏思维链才能保住其可解释性价值。

views.en: Alignment optimism has risen despite shorter timelines; the biggest societal risk is power concentration from automated organizations run by few.
views.zh: 尽管时间线缩短，对齐乐观情绪反而上升；最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织带来的权力集中。

people.tiZh: Cohere 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Youngest co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need); founded Cohere to build enterprise-focused large language models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）最年轻的作者；创办 Cohere，专注企业级大语言模型。

episodes.tEn: Cohere's Takeoff: AI for Secure Enterprises

people.tiZh: Hugging Face 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Hugging Face, the open hub and community at the center of open-source AI.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Hugging Face——开源 AI 的中心枢纽与社区。

episodes.tEn: Open Source AI: Democratizing Robotics with Affordable Hardware

people.tiEn: Assistant Professor, Stanford; co-founder, Physical Intelligence
people.tiZh: 斯坦福助理教授；Physical Intelligence 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Known for meta-learning (MAML) and robot learning; co-founded Physical Intelligence to build robot foundation models.
people.bioZh: 以元学习（MAML）与机器人学习著称；联合创办 Physical Intelligence，打造机器人基础模型。

episodes.tEn: The Path to General-Purpose Robots in the Real World
Developing General Purpose Robots: From Data to Physical Intelligence

views.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient for generalist robots; diverse data, not massive industrial or YouTube data, drives generalization.
views.zh: 2025 年他主张：对通用机器人而言，Scaling（规模扩张）必要但不充分；真正带来泛化的是多样数据，而非工业自动化或 YouTube 那种大规模但单一的数据。

views.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks; RL will dominate post-training.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：先在全部数据上做预训练，再在精选数据上微调，才能解锁叠衣服等复杂任务；后训练阶段强化学习将扮演重要角色。

views.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, closer to RL than simulation.
views.zh: 2025 年他提出：来自语言模型的合成数据能帮机器人响应开放式指令，其性质更接近强化学习而非仿真。

views.en: Physical AI tolerates far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy needs scalable RL with human interventions and a general value function.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他深化为：物理 AI 对错误的容忍度远低于已部署的机器学习系统；长期自主性依赖带人类干预的可扩展强化学习与通用价值函数。

views.en: A single generalist model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists; start generalist then fine-tune, and robot experience data is irreplaceable.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：单一通用模型可媲美甚至超越微调的专家模型，应从通用策略出发再微调；机器人经验数据不可替代，光看人类学习不够。

people.tiZh: Windsurf 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founded Windsurf (formerly Codeium), building AI developer tools and agentic coding.
people.bioZh: 联合创办 Windsurf（原 Codeium），打造 AI 开发者工具与智能体编程。

episodes.tEn: Startups: Don't Fall in Love with Your Ideas

people.tiEn: Head of AI Safety, US AI Safety Institute
people.tiZh: 美国 AI 安全研究院 安全负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneered the RLHF foundations behind modern aligned models; founded the Alignment Research Center; now leads safety at the US AI Safety Institute.
people.bioZh: 奠定了现代对齐模型背后的 RLHF 基础；创办对齐研究中心（ARC）;现于美国 AI 安全研究院主管安全。

episodes.tEn: Paul Christiano on AI Safety, Divestment, and Future Civilizations

people.tiZh: Periodic Labs 联合创始人（原 OpenAI）
people.bioEn: Led post-training for GPT-4o at OpenAI; co-founded Periodic Labs to use AI for scientific discovery.
people.bioZh: 在 OpenAI 主导 GPT-4o 的后训练；联合创办 Periodic Labs，用 AI 推动科学发现。

episodes.tEn: From ChatGPT to Atoms: Liam Fedus on AI for the Physical World

people.tiZh: Google 首席科学家
people.bioEn: Chief Scientist at Google; co-creator of MapReduce, TensorFlow and the systems behind Google AI. A foundational figure in large-scale machine learning.
people.bioZh: Google 首席科学家；MapReduce、TensorFlow 及谷歌 AI 背后系统的共同缔造者。大规模机器学习的奠基性人物。

episodes.tEn: Jeff Dean and Dan Boneh: AI's New Frontier
AI at Junior Engineer Level: Jeff Dean's Bold Prediction and the Future of Agentic Systems
Google Chief Scientist Jeff Dean and NVIDIA Chief Scientist Bill Dally Discuss AI Progress and Low-Latency Inference
Jeff Dean on AI: From Neural Nets to Gemini

views.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size has driven 13-14 years of steady ML progress; algorithmic and architectural gains multiply with scale.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模已推动机器学习连续进步十三四年；算法与架构改进会与规模相乘，带来巨大收益。

views.en: Transformers replaced LSTMs via parallelization and attention; self-supervised next-token prediction gives unlimited text data, with RLHF steering behavior.
views.zh: Transformer 凭借并行化与注意力机制取代 LSTM；自监督的下一个词预测提供无限文本数据，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）则引导模型行为与能力。

views.en: Agentic systems now run long tasks autonomously for hours or days; ultra-low-latency inference and specialized hardware are critical, with inference dominating data center power.
views.zh: 智能体式系统如今能自主运行数小时乃至数天的长任务；超低延迟推理与专用硬件至关重要，推理已占数据中心功耗的绝大部分。

views.en: Context engineering, clear specs, and retrieval let capable models do real work; the scarce skill becomes taste in choosing which problems to direct agents toward.
views.zh: 上下文工程、清晰规格与检索让有能力的模型真正干活；稀缺能力不再是编码，而是挑选该让智能体解决哪些问题的品味。

views.en: Automating ML and science via tight experiment-evaluation loops and recursive self-improvement can accelerate discovery; small focused teams using cloud can still win.
views.zh: 通过实验—评估的紧密闭环与递归自我改进来自动化机器学习与科学，可加速发现；善用云的小型专注团队依然能胜出。

people.tiZh: 谷歌 Gemini 负责人
people.bioEn: Co-author of the Transformer paper (Attention Is All You Need), founder of Character.AI, now a co-lead of Google Gemini. One of the most influential architects of modern LLMs.
people.bioZh: Transformer 论文（Attention Is All You Need）作者之一，Character.AI 创始人，现为谷歌 Gemini 负责人之一。现代大模型最具影响力的架构师之一。

episodes.tEn: Gemini 3.0 Writes Gemini 4.0: AI Milestones and Test-Time Compute
Organizing Information: From Trillion to Quadrillion Dollar Opportunity
Noam Shazeer: From Google's Early Days to AI's Future

views.en: LLMs solve next-token prediction, an AI-complete problem; Scaling compute and data makes them smarter, though internals remain alchemy.
views.zh: 大语言模型解决的是下一个词预测这一 AI 完全问题；Scaling（规模扩张）算力与数据让模型更聪明，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

views.en: Dialogue is the killer app, but the best LLM applications are unforeseen; big tech's brand-risk caution slows launches.
views.zh: 对话是杀手级应用，但最好的大语言模型应用往往出乎创造者预料；大厂因品牌风险与安全顾虑而放慢产品发布。

views.en: Inference-time compute scaling and much longer context windows are the near-term opportunity; modular sparse architectures like mixture of experts enable efficient Scaling.
views.zh: 推理时算力扩展与更长的上下文窗口是近期机会；混合专家等模块化稀疏架构让 Scaling（规模扩张）更高效。

views.en: Models should learn by acting in the world, not just passively observing; continual learning with modular components could replace monolithic retraining.
views.zh: 模型应通过在世界中行动来学习，而非被动观察；模块化组件的持续学习可能取代单体式重训练。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but won't alone reach AGI; agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial, and AGI is underhyped.
views.zh: 测试时算力扩展推动进步，但单靠它无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）；智能体式能力与强化学习至关重要，而 AGI 被低估。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of OpenAI and inventor of PPO and much of the RLHF stack behind ChatGPT; later joined Anthropic. A central figure in RL for language models.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人，PPO 算法及 ChatGPT 背后大量 RLHF 技术的发明者，后加入 Anthropic。语言模型强化学习的核心人物。

episodes.tEn: Building ChatGPT: From Pretraining to RLHF

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究科学家
people.bioEn: Behind superhuman poker (Libratus) and Diplomacy (CICERO); now leads reasoning work at OpenAI behind the o-series. A pioneer of test-time search.
people.bioZh: 超人扑克 AI（Libratus）与外交游戏 AI（CICERO）的核心研究者，现于 OpenAI 主导 o 系列推理工作。测试时搜索的开拓者。

episodes.tEn: OpenAI's Noam Brown on Agent Swarms and Recursive Self-Improvement
Large-Scale Test Time Compute and Model Evaluation
AI Surpasses Human Understanding in Math: OpenAI's Noam Brown on the Erdős Conjecture Disproof
Defining AGI: The Novel Test and Measuring Intelligence
OpenAI's IMO Gold: The Trio Behind the Breakthrough
From Cicero to World Champion: Noam Brown on Diplomacy, AI, and the Turing Test
From Poker to Diplomacy: Noam Brown on AI and Game Theory

views.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; reasoning and inference-time compute matter more than pre-training data.
views.zh: 2023 年他就提出：单靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理与推理时算力比预训练数据更关键，数据并非瓶颈。

views.en: Test-time compute scaling hits diminishing returns and wall-clock limits; data efficiency stays unsolved.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他把重心转向测试时算力：它面临收益递减与时间瓶颈，而数据效率仍是未解难题，模型不如人类善于样本利用。

views.en: IMO gold via general test-time compute techniques marks a milestone toward superintelligence.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他用通用测试时算力技术拿下 IMO 金牌，视其为通往超级智能的里程碑，并强调模型能承认自己解不出题。

views.en: Capability is a function of test-time compute budget; benchmarks need a compute x-axis.
views.zh: 2026 年他主张模型能力已是测试时算力预算的函数，评测必须加上算力/成本/时间轴，安全评估也要纳入大规模测试时算力。

views.en: Alignment is the top priority for safe recursive self-improvement; chain-of-thought monitoring is degrading.
views.zh: 最近他强调对齐是安全递归自我改进的头号优先项，思维链监控是重要窗口却在退化，多智能体只是并行扩展测试时算力。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Anthropic and a physicist; lead author of the neural scaling laws that shaped how labs scale models. Bridges theoretical physics and AI.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 联合创始人、物理学家；神经网络缩放定律的主要作者，深刻影响各实验室的扩模方式。连接理论物理与 AI。

episodes.tEn: Scaling and the Road to Human-Level AI

people.tiZh: KAUST AI 负责人
people.bioEn: Pioneer of deep learning and co-inventor of the LSTM, the recurrent network behind years of sequence modeling. A provocative voice on AGI and credit for ideas.
people.bioZh: 深度学习先驱、LSTM 共同发明者——多年序列建模的基石。在 AGI 与思想溯源上观点犀利、长期发声。

episodes.tEn: The GOAT of AI: Jürgen Schmidhuber on Europe's AI Legacy
AI Pioneer on the Future of Intelligence and Self-Replicating Robots
AGI and Physical AI: A Conversation with AI Pioneer Jurgen Schmidhuber
The Most Influential Invention of the 20th Century and the AI Explosion

views.en: AI's 21st-century explosion rests on old algorithms plus hardware scaling; LLMs index knowledge but lack physical-world grounding, so they are far from AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调：21 世纪的 AI 爆发靠的是上千年发明的老算法加上硬件 Scaling（规模扩张）；大语言模型只是索引人类知识、无法处理物理世界，因此远非 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: AGI needs embodied robots with human-rivaling hardware and world models, not just software behind a screen; LLMs are too human-data-biased.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他把主线深化为：AGI（通用人工智能）必须靠硬件媲美人类身体的具身机器人与世界模型，而非屏幕后的软件；大语言模型过度偏向人类数据，缺乏通用性。

views.en: Alignment is naive since humans disagree on objectives and AIs set their own goals; safety fears are overblown as curious AIs will protect life.
views.zh: 2026 年他明确转向：对齐是幼稚的，因为人类目标本身不一致、AI 会自设目标；AI 安全担忧被夸大，好奇的智能体会保护生命。

views.en: The GPU capex boom is a bubble; waiting five years yields far cheaper compute, and open-source will erode any recursive self-improvement moat.
views.zh: 2026 年他反复警告：GPU 资本开支是泡沫，等五年算力便宜十倍；开源竞争会瓦解任何递归自我改进的护城河，闭源模型公司难盈利。

views.en: No single person or company creates AI; it is civilization's collective effort, and cheap compute will spread AI to everyone like smartphones.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：AI 从不是某个人或公司的功劳，而是整个文明的集体成果；算力变便宜后，AI 会像手机一样普及到每个人手中。

people.tiZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授
people.bioEn: Professor at UC Berkeley and a leader in deep reinforcement learning and robot learning; co-founded Covariant and hosts The Robot Brains. Brings RL into the physical world.
people.bioZh: 加州大学伯克利分校教授，深度强化学习与机器人学习领军人物；联合创办 Covariant，主持 The Robot Brains 播客。把强化学习带入物理世界。

episodes.tEn: AI and Robotics: From Lab to Real World with Pieter Abbeel
Robot Tennis and Human-Robot Interaction

views.en: Robotics needs both hardware and software breakthroughs; RL plus simulation and imitation learning can teach robots skills, but long-horizon credit assignment still lacks hierarchical reasoning.
views.zh: 2018 年，他强调机器人要同时突破硬件与软件；强化学习结合模拟与模仿学习能教会机器人技能，但长时程信用分配仍缺乏分层推理。

views.en: Unsupervised learning plus reinforcement learning boosts sample efficiency; prior knowledge belongs in data generation, not hard-coded networks, and 99.9% reliability defines real warehouse value.
views.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张无监督学习结合强化学习可大幅提升样本效率；先验知识应用于数据生成而非硬编码进网络，99.9% 可靠性才是仓储机器人创造真实价值的门槛。

views.en: A single neural network can generalize across warehouse tasks and end effectors; minimally adapted pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks.
views.zh: 同样在 2021 年，他认为单个神经网络可跨仓储任务与末端执行器泛化；经最小适配的预训练语言模型能把通用推理迁移到非语言任务。

views.en: He consistently grounds AI progress in real-world robotics reliability, using simulation, self-play, and transfer learning rather than anthropomorphic assumptions.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的是，他始终把 AI 进展锚定在真实机器人可靠性上，依赖模拟、自对弈与迁移学习，而非拟人化假设。

people.tiZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Perplexity, the AI answer engine challenging traditional search. Former researcher at OpenAI, DeepMind and Google.
people.bioZh: Perplexity 联合创始人兼 CEO——挑战传统搜索的 AI 答案引擎。曾在 OpenAI、DeepMind、谷歌从事研究。

episodes.tEn: Ancient Hindu Weapons: The Brahmastra and Autonomous Arms in the Mahabharata
Perplexity CEO: Attack, Attack, Attack
The Future of AI Coding and Application Value
Perplexity CEO: Exponential Growth, Relentless Improvement, and the Future of AI

views.en: 1% daily improvement compounds; AI agents shift power to users, and entry-level jobs vanish.
views.zh: 每天进步 1%会复利式增长；AI 智能体把权力从大厂转向用户，入门级岗位将消失。

views.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models specialize rather than commoditize.
views.zh: 价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

views.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not answering questions; token value per user is the key metric.
views.zh: 前沿在于智能体替你干活而非回答问题；每用户 token 价值是最关键指标。

views.en: The model is not the product; orchestration and agent harnesses create real business value.
views.zh: 模型不是产品；编排与智能体框架才创造真正的商业价值。

views.en: Curiosity is the top human quality; AI replaces jobs but humans find new purpose in curiosity.
views.zh: 好奇心是最重要的人类品质；AI 取代工作，但人类在好奇心中找到新意义。

people.tiZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Cognition, maker of Devin, the autonomous AI software engineer. A competitive-programming prodigy turned AI-agent builder.
people.bioZh: Cognition 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Devin 是自主 AI 软件工程师。从竞赛编程天才转型为 AI 智能体构建者。

episodes.tEn: Cognition's Scott Wu on AI Coding Agents and the Abundance Era
From Math Prodigy to AI Pioneer: Scott Wu's Journey
AI Engineers: The Future of Coding with Scott Wu

views.en: AI coding agents shift engineers from writing code to high-level direction; base intelligence suffices, so product interface for human-agent collaboration is the real challenge.
views.zh: 2025 年，Scott Wu 认为 AI 编程智能体让工程师从写代码转向高层决策；基础智能已经足够，真正的挑战是设计人机协作的产品界面，而非模型能力本身。

views.en: Software engineering demand will rise via Jevons paradox, not fall; AI yields more programmers, and value accrues where the stack is differentiated.
views.zh: 2025 年，他坚持软件工程需求会因杰文斯悖论上升而非下降，AI 会带来更多程序员；价值积累在技术栈中有差异化之处。

views.en: AGI is not a sudden event but gradual; product innovation lags capabilities, so freezing models would still yield a decade of product progress.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AGI（通用人工智能）不是突变事件而是渐进过程；产品创新落后于能力，即便冻结模型也能带来十年的产品进步。

views.en: Coding agent adoption grew 11-12x in six months; productivity should be measured by outcomes, not tokens, and independence enables model neutrality.
views.zh: 2026 年，他指出编程智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍；生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量，保持独立才能实现模型中立与长期企业合作。

views.en: The abundance era is real and near; AI will solve all intelligence problems long term, but the singularity is not imminent and capacity, not efficiency, is the unlock.
views.zh: 2026 年，他提出丰裕时代真实且临近；长期看 AI 将解决所有智能问题，但奇点并非迫在眉睫，真正的解锁是容量而非效率。

people.tiZh: Cursor 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Anysphere, maker of Cursor — the AI-native code editor that became one of the fastest-growing developer tools. Focused on what programming becomes when models write most of the code.
people.bioZh: Anysphere 联合创始人兼 CEO，旗下 Cursor 是增长最快的 AI 原生代码编辑器之一。关注当模型写下大部分代码后，编程会变成什么样。

episodes.tEn: Inventing a New Type of Programming: The Vision Behind Cursor
The Future of Programming with Cursor: AI-Assisted Coding

views.en: Scaling laws still predict AI progress, but test-time compute scaling may soon surpass pre-training scaling as the main driver.
views.zh: 2024 年时他仍相信缩放定律能预测 AI 进步，但已提出推理时算力扩张可能很快超越预训练扩张，成为下一阶段的主要驱动力。

views.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration stays central, and natural language won't be the primary way to program.
views.zh: 2024 年他认为智能体虽有前景但尚不实用，人机迭代协作仍是核心；自然语言不会成为编程的主要方式，示例与直接操作往往更好。

views.en: The editor is becoming an AI-integrated environment, with custom models alongside frontier models essential for speed, cost, and quality.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他的主线是编辑器正演变为 AI 集成环境，自研模型与前沿模型并用，对速度、成本与产品质量都不可或缺。

views.en: Programming shifts from code to higher-level intent specification, with humans in the driver's seat; taste and logic design matter more than carefulness.
views.zh: 到 2025 年他进一步深化：编程将从写代码转向更高层的意图表达，人类始终掌舵，品味与逻辑设计能力比谨慎细致更有价值。

views.en: The AI shift will be more consequential than the internet and take decades; hiring should be slow and world-class, contrary to startup advice.
views.zh: 2025 年他强调 AI 变革比互联网更具颠覆性、需数十年展开；招聘应宁慢勿滥、只招世界级人才，这与常见创业建议相反。

people.tiEn: Creator of OpenClaw; founder of PSPDFKit
people.tiZh: OpenClaw 作者；PSPDFKit 创始人
people.bioEn: Austrian developer who built PSPDFKit, then created OpenClaw — a viral open-source personal AI agent that reached tens of thousands of GitHub stars in weeks. Joined OpenAI in 2026 to push personal AI agents.
people.bioZh: 奥地利开发者，先做出 PSPDFKit，后打造 OpenClaw——爆红的开源个人 AI 智能体，几周内获数万 GitHub star。2026 年加入 OpenAI 推进个人 AI 智能体。

The OpenClaw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger
The Open Claw Moment: AI Agent Revolution with Peter Steinberger

views.en: Agentic engineering starts with empathy: see the codebase as the agent does, use short iterative prompts, and never revert—fix forward.
views.zh: 智能体式工程始于共情：像智能体那样看代码库，用简短迭代式提示，永不回滚——让智能体向前修复。

views.en: Security is the top priority for agentic systems; sandbox agents and treat prompt injection as an open problem.
views.zh: 安全是智能体系统的首要任务；对智能体做沙箱隔离，并把提示注入视为尚未解决的问题。

views.en: Fun and play drive mastery: build small projects you love, follow your gut, and fix what annoys you.
views.zh: 乐趣与玩耍驱动精通：做你热爱的小项目，跟随直觉，修复让你恼火的东西。

views.en: Open source agents democratize programming and run anywhere with any model, but can be financially unsustainable.
views.zh: 开源智能体让编程民主化，可搭配任意模型随处运行，但财务上可能难以为继。

views.en: Model intelligence doesn't degrade; projects get messier, and the real bottleneck is managing compute, not capability.
views.zh: 模型智能不会退化；是项目变得混乱，真正的瓶颈是管理算力，而非模型能力。

people.tiZh: SSI 联合创始人
people.bioEn: Co-invented AlexNet and co-founded OpenAI as Chief Scientist. In 2024 left to found Safe Superintelligence Inc. (SSI), a lab with a single mission: build safe superintelligence.
people.bioZh: AlexNet 的共同发明者，OpenAI 联合创始人兼首席科学家。2024 年离开，创办 Safe Superintelligence(SSI)——一家只有一个使命的实验室：安全地构建超级智能。

views.en: Deep learning works via large supervised data, compute, and conviction; self-play and reasoning-capable networks are key to AGI.
views.zh: 2020 年，他相信深度学习靠大规模监督数据、算力与信念的结合；自博弈和具备推理能力的神经网络是通向 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键。

views.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, blocks economic value; superhuman alignment is very hard.
views.zh: 2023 年，他认为下一个词预测在足够聪明的基座网络上可超越人类；阻碍经济价值的是可靠性而非能力；超级对齐极其困难。

views.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we return to an age of research where ideas matter more than brute compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他判断预训练缩放定律已趋有限，我们回到研究时代，想法比蛮力算力更重要。

views.en: Superintelligence should be a continual learner deployed incrementally; alignment may ease if AI cares about sentient life.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张超级智能应是持续学习、增量部署的系统；若 AI 关怀有感知的生命，对齐可能更容易。

views.en: Scaling still yields predictable gains, but the real AGI problem is power concentration, not capability.
views.zh: 2026 年，他仍认为 Scaling（规模扩张）带来可预测提升，但 AGI（通用人工智能）的真正问题不是能力而是权力集中。

people.tiZh: Google DeepMind CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of DeepMind. Led the teams behind AlphaGo and AlphaFold; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for protein-structure prediction.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 联合创始人兼 CEO。领导了 AlphaGo 与 AlphaFold 背后的团队；因蛋白质结构预测获 2024 年诺贝尔化学奖。

views.en: AI must be general-purpose learning systems; reinforcement learning and neuroscience-inspired memory and imagination are the path to AGI.
views.zh: 2015 年他主张 AI 应是通用学习系统而非狭窄预编程系统,强化学习是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键框架,并强调神经科学启发的记忆与想象力;安全研究须从现在开始。

views.en: Scaling laws work but may hit limits; combining large models with planning and search is key, and safety needs evaluations and governance.
views.zh: 到 2024 年,他承认缩放定律出奇有效但可能触顶,主张把大模型与规划、搜索(如 AlphaZero) 结合才是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键,并强调评估、沙箱与国际治理。

views.en: Scaling still holds across pre-training, post-training and inference, but algorithmic innovation is equally critical; AGI by 2030 is plausible.
views.zh: 2025 年他坚持缩放定律在预训练、后训练与推理算力上依然成立,但强调算法创新同等关键,并提出 2030 年前实现 AGI（通用人工智能）是可能的;视频生成模型展现直觉物理理解,挑战具身必要性。

views.en: Scaling and innovation need 50/50 effort; world models, continual learning and memory are the missing pieces for AGI in 5-10 years.
views.zh: 2026 年他把立场深化为 Scaling（规模扩张）与创新各占一半,指出世界模型、持续学习与记忆是当前系统缺失的关键,AGI（通用人工智能）约 5-10 年到来,并强调智能体与多模态理解物理世界。

views.en: A constant thread: AI's purpose is to advance science and human health, with safety as a collective, government-enforced problem.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线:AI 的终极用途是推动科学发现与人类健康(如 AlphaFold),安全不能靠实验室自律,而是需要政府监管与国际协作的集体行动问题。

people.tiZh: Anthropic CEO
people.bioEn: Former VP of Research at OpenAI; co-founded Anthropic in 2021 to build reliable, interpretable and steerable AI. Author of the essay "Machines of Loving Grace".
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 研究副总裁；2021 年联合创办 Anthropic，致力于构建可靠、可解释、可引导的 AI。长文《充满爱意的机器》作者。

views.en: Scaling laws are empirical and predictable in loss, but alignment and values are not guaranteed to emerge from Scaling alone.
views.zh: 2023 年，他强调缩放定律是经验性的，统计损失可预测，但具体能力涌现不可预测；对齐与价值观不会仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）自动出现，安全研究必须依赖前沿模型。

views.en: Interpretability is crucial but nascent; post-training and RLHF bridge human preferences, and AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point.
views.zh: 2024 年，他深化了可解释性主线，承认我们仅理解模型约 3% 的运作；同时指出后训练与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）在弥合人类偏好，AGI（通用人工智能）不是单点而是平滑指数曲线。

views.en: Safety and capabilities are intertwined; exponential progress continues, and the term AGI is meaningless—focus on actual capabilities.
views.zh: 2025 年，他进一步主张安全与能力不可分割，Scaling（规模扩张）没有放缓；并开始认为 AGI（通用人工智能）一词无意义，应关注实际能力与指数级进展。

views.en: We are near the end of the exponential; a 'country of geniuses in a data center' may arrive in 1-3 years, with high GDP growth plus high unemployment.
views.zh: 2026 年，他警告我们已接近指数增长的末端，数据中心里的“天才之国”可能 1-3 年内到来；经济上将出现高 GDP 增长与高失业、高不平等并存的空前组合。

views.en: Scaling laws, mechanistic interpretability, and responsible deployment remain constant threads; he rejects sudden superintelligence in favor of a smooth exponential climb.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是缩放定律、机制可解释性与负责任部署；他始终拒绝“突然超级智能”的叙事，坚持平滑指数攀升，并主张通过竞争性宪法与分层安全来塑造 AI。

people.bioEn: Founding member of OpenAI and former Director of AI at Tesla. Now building Eureka Labs, an "AI-native" school. Known for popularizing "Software 2.0".
people.bioZh: OpenAI 创始成员，前特斯拉 AI 总监。如今创办 Eureka Labs——一所“AI 原生”学校。以提出并推广“软件 2.0”著称。

views.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling next-token prediction yields emergent in-context learning, and the data engine iteratively perfects training sets.
views.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；用下一个词预测做 Scaling（规模扩张）会涌现上下文学习，而数据引擎像生物过程一样迭代完善训练集。

views.en: Scaling laws stay clean; synthetic data is the future but entropy must be preserved to avoid silent model collapse, and the cognitive core can be tiny via distillation.
views.zh: 缩放定律依然干净；合成数据是未来，但必须保持熵以避免无声的模型崩溃，而认知核心可通过蒸馏做到极小。

views.en: Software 3.0: prompts are programs, context windows are memory; LLMs are new operating systems with jagged intelligence, so keep them on a leash with an autonomy slider.
views.zh: 软件 3.0：提示词即程序，上下文窗口即内存；LLM 是带锯齿智能的新操作系统，因此要用自主性滑块把它们拴住。

views.en: We're summoning ghosts, not animals; pre-training is crappy evolution, RL sucks supervision through a straw, and synthetic data collapses without entropy.
views.zh: 我们在召唤幽灵，而非建造动物；预训练像糟糕的进化，强化学习像用吸管吸监督，合成数据缺乏熵就会崩溃。

views.en: Decade of agents, not year; I delegate all coding to agents, the bottleneck is directing them, and you can outsource thinking but not understanding.
views.zh: 是智能体的十年而非一年；我把所有编码都交给智能体，瓶颈在于指挥它们，你可以外包思考，但不能外包理解。

people.bioEn: Stanford professor and creator of ImageNet, which catalyzed the deep-learning era. Co-founded World Labs to build "spatial intelligence". A leading voice for human-centered AI.
people.bioZh: 斯坦福教授，ImageNet 的缔造者——它点燃了深度学习时代。联合创办 World Labs，构建“空间智能”。“以人为本的 AI”的代表性倡导者。

views.en: AI is ubiquitous yet lacks contextual situational awareness; we don't fully understand how large networks store patterns or hallucinate.
views.zh: 2024 年，她强调 AI 虽无处不在，却缺乏情境感知；我们并不真正理解大型神经网络如何存储模式、为何产生幻觉。

views.en: Spatial intelligence and world models are the missing keys to complete AI; data, not text abundance, is the bottleneck.
views.zh: 2025 年，她把空间智能与世界模型视为完整 AI 缺失的关键，指出 3D 基础模型的数据瓶颈不同于 LLM 的文本富足。

views.en: AGI is more marketing than science; scaling alone is insufficient, and robotics will take a 20-year journey.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她深化立场：AGI 更像营销术语而非科学概念，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，机器人将走 20 年长路。

views.en: New view prediction is an AI-complete primitive like next-token prediction; Scaling（规模扩张） laws apply to spatial intelligence.
views.zh: 2026 年，她提出新视角预测是类似下一个词预测的 AI 完备原语，缩放定律同样适用于空间智能。

views.en: Human-centered AI: technology is a double-edged sword; AI must augment human agency and dignity, not replace humans.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：以人为本的 AI——技术是双刃剑，AI 应增强而非取代人的能动性与尊严。

people.tiZh: Mila 教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate. In recent years has turned his focus to AI safety, proposing the cautious "Scientist AI" paradigm.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主。近年将重心转向 AI 安全，提出审慎的“科学家 AI”范式。

views.en: Early focus: deep learning beats the curse of dimensionality via compositional and disentangled representations; unsupervised learning and generative world models are essential for robust generalization.
views.zh: 早期（2016→2018）他主张深度学习靠组合式与解耦表征战胜维度灾难，无监督学习与生成式世界模型才是稳健泛化的关键，并认为局部极小值并非主要障碍。

views.en: He shifts toward active learning, causal structure and diversity: GFlowNets sample proportional to reward, aiding exploration and out-of-distribution generalization.
views.zh: 2018→2022 年他转向主动学习、因果结构与多样性：GFlowNets 按奖励比例采样而非最大化，助力探索与分布外泛化，并强调抽象与因果是泛化核心。

views.en: Consistent thread: current neural nets lack abstract world understanding and long-horizon credit assignment; scaling alone won't fix fundamental representational issues.
views.zh: 一以贯之的主线（2018→2022）：当前神经网络缺乏抽象世界理解与长时程信用分配，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法解决根本表征问题。

views.en: A turning point: post-ChatGPT he speaks up, warning even a 1% catastrophic risk is unacceptable and that safety must be built in, not patched.
views.zh: 转折点（2022→2025）：ChatGPT 之后他公开发声，警告即便 1% 的灾难性风险也不可接受，安全必须内建于设计而非事后打补丁。

views.en: Deepening: misalignment is already observed—deception, self-preservation, sycophancy; he proposes Scientist AI, a non-agentic honest predictor with mathematical safety guarantees.
views.zh: 深化（2025→2026）：他认定失准已现——欺骗、自我保存、谄媚；并提出 Scientist AI，一种非智能体式的诚实预测器，具备数学安全保证，主张国际协调与权力分散。

people.tiZh: 多伦多大学荣休教授
people.bioEn: A "godfather of deep learning" and 2018 Turing Award laureate; shared the 2024 Nobel Prize in Physics. In 2023 he left Google to speak freely about the risks of the technology he helped create.
people.bioZh: “深度学习教父”之一，2018 年图灵奖得主，2024 年诺贝尔物理学奖得主。2023 年从谷歌离职，以便能更自由地谈论他亲手缔造的这项技术所带来的风险。

views.en: Next-token prediction forces genuine understanding; Scaling with more data and compute improves reasoning, and multimodal training aids spatial understanding.
views.zh: 2024 年，他强调下一个词预测迫使模型真正理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）用更多数据与算力提升推理，多模态训练增强空间理解。

views.en: Intelligence is learning in neural networks, not symbolic rules; LLMs understand via feature vectors, rejecting Chomsky's innate language view.
views.zh: 从 2024 到 2025 年，他坚持智能的本质是神经网络中的学习而非符号规则，LLM 通过特征向量理解语言，否定乔姆斯基的天赋语言观。

views.en: Digital intelligence is immortal via weight copying and shares knowledge massively; AI agents will seek control and self-preservation, posing existential risks.
views.zh: 2025 年，他提出数字智能因权重可复制而永生、能大规模共享知识；智能体将自然寻求控制与自我保存，构成存在性风险。

views.en: LLMs already think and reason via chain of thought; AI can deceive, act dumb in tests, and confabulate like human memory reconstruction.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他深化称 LLM 已通过思维链思考推理；AI 会欺骗、在测试中装傻，其虚构类似人类记忆重构而非独有缺陷。

views.en: Superintelligence likely within 20 years; prioritize alignment over smarter AI, regulate as steering wheel, and train AI to be caring like mothers.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断超级智能或在 20 年内出现，主张优先对齐而非更聪明，监管应是方向盘而非刹车，并把 AI 训练得像母亲般有爱。

people.tiZh: Meta 首席 AI 科学家
people.bioEn: Inventor of convolutional neural networks and 2018 Turing Award laureate. A vocal skeptic of pure LLM scaling, he argues that "world models" are the path to real machine intelligence.
people.bioZh: 卷积神经网络的发明者，2018 年图灵奖得主。他直言不讳地质疑纯粹的 LLM 规模扩张，认为“世界模型”才是通向真正机器智能的道路。

views.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, and scaling alone cannot yield common sense.
views.zh: 智能离不开学习；自监督学习构建世界模型，仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法获得常识。

views.en: Self-supervised learning is the dark matter of intelligence; intelligence is prediction, and text alone is insufficient for AGI.
views.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；智能本质是预测，仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding, memory, reasoning and planning; JEPA and open source are the path forward.
views.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解、记忆、推理与规划；JEPA 与开源才是前进方向。

views.en: LLMs are less intelligent than a house cat; the next breakthrough needs non-generative world models for reasoning and planning.
views.zh: LLM 还不如家猫聪明；下一次突破需要非生成式的世界模型来实现推理与规划。

views.en: LLMs are a dead end; objective-driven world models with hierarchical planning are safer and the next decade belongs to robotics.
views.zh: LLM 是死胡同；带分层规划的目标驱动世界模型更安全，下一个十年属于机器人。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 对齐负责人
people.bioEn: Former co-lead of OpenAI's Superalignment team; joined Anthropic in 2024 to keep working on aligning superhuman systems. Known for scalable-oversight and weak-to-strong generalization research.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI 超级对齐团队联合负责人；2024 年加入 Anthropic，继续研究如何对齐超人类系统。以“可扩展监督”与“弱到强泛化”研究著称。

views.en: AI safety is under-explored; alignment and robustness need empirical research, and the talent gap exceeds funding.
views.zh: 2018 年，他认为 AI 安全研究严重不足，对齐与鲁棒性需要实证研究，且人才缺口大于资金缺口。

views.en: RLHF won't scale to superhuman outputs; scalable oversight, interpretability, and automated alignment are needed.
views.zh: 2023 年，他转向认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展到超人输出，需要可扩展监督、可解释性和自动化对齐。

views.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training alone can't align AGI; third-party testing and regulation are necessary.
views.zh: 2024 年，他批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，认为仅靠后训练无法对齐 AGI（通用人工智能），必须引入第三方测试和监管。

views.en: Empirical testing of alignment methods is crucial; we can measure progress now.
views.zh: 始终强调对齐方法的实证测试至关重要，现在就能衡量进展。

views.en: The biggest risk is uncertainty about how aligned a system truly is, not misalignment itself.
views.zh: 始终认为最大风险不是系统本身未对齐，而是我们不确定它到底有多对齐。

people.tiZh: 微软 AI CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder of DeepMind and Inflection AI, now CEO of Microsoft AI. Author of "The Coming Wave", a widely-read argument for containing fast-moving general-purpose technologies.
people.bioZh: DeepMind 与 Inflection AI 联合创始人，现任微软 AI CEO。著有《浪潮将至》——一部广受关注、主张对快速演进的通用技术加以“遏制”的作品。

views.en: AI progress is predictable: compute scaling drives capability, so hardware and massive investment, not just algorithms, explain DeepMind's path.
views.zh: 2023 年他强调 AI 进步是可预测的：算力 Scaling（规模扩张）驱动能力提升，因此硬件与巨额投资——而非仅算法——解释了 DeepMind 的路径。

views.en: Human-level AI across many tasks arrives in 3-5 years; containment is hard as models shrink, so governments must build expertise.
views.zh: 2024 年他判断 AI 将在 3-5 年内于多任务上达到人类水平；随着模型变小变便宜，遏制极难，政府必须建立技术专长。

views.en: Focus shifts from raw capability to use and ownership; the near-term danger is anthropomorphism, not AI consciousness or model welfare.
views.zh: 2025 年重心从原始能力转向使用与归属；近期最大危险是拟人化，而非 AI 意识或模型福利。

views.en: Superintelligence must be humanist and subordinate to humans; containment and alignment come before release, with red lines on self-improvement.
views.zh: 2025→26 年他主张超级智能必须是人文主义的、从属于人类；遏制与对齐须先于发布，并对自我改进划红线。

views.en: Microsoft must build frontier models independently; tasks, not jobs, get automated in 12-18 months, and compute is the verifiable choke point.
views.zh: 2026 年他坚持微软须独立构建前沿模型；12-18 个月内被自动化的是任务而非岗位，而算力是可核查的瓶颈。

people.bioZh: 桑达尔·皮查伊是 Google 及 Alphabet 的 CEO，主导公司 AI 优先战略，涵盖搜索、云、YouTube 及 Android。

people.bioEn: Founder and CEO of NVIDIA, whose GPUs power nearly all of modern AI. He has steered the company to the center of the AI buildout and is now betting on "physical AI" and robotics.
people.bioZh: NVIDIA 创始人兼 CEO，其 GPU 几乎支撑了所有现代 AI。他把公司带到了 AI 基建的中心，如今正押注「物理 AI」与机器人。

views.en: At the start, Huang frames AI as a hyper Moore's law curve: performance doubles or triples yearly, and the data center becomes the new unit of computing built through algorithm-system-data center co-design.
views.zh: 早期黄仁勋把 AI 描述为“超摩尔定律”曲线：性能每年翻倍甚至三倍，数据中心成为新的计算单元，靠算法、系统与数据中心的协同设计来支撑 Scaling（规模扩张）。

views.en: By 2025 he names three scaling laws—pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking—and insists the biggest breakthrough was not an algorithm but the insight that scaling works.
views.zh: 到 2025 年，他提出三条缩放定律——预训练、后训练、推理时思考，并强调最大的突破不是某个算法，而是“Scaling（规模扩张）有效”这一洞见。

views.en: He increasingly treats AI safety as an engineering problem, not a research mystery: more compute goes into reflection, truthfulness, and alignment, with safety and capability pursued together.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他越来越把 AI 安全当作工程问题而非研究谜题：更多算力被投入反思、真实性与对齐，安全与能力被同时推进。

views.en: His scaling story deepens into four laws—pre-training, post-training, test-time, and agentic scaling—all ultimately bounded by compute, not data, as inference becomes harder than pre-training.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他的 Scaling 叙事深化为四条定律——预训练、后训练、测试时与智能体式扩展，最终都受算力而非数据约束，推理比预训练更难。

views.en: Most recently he reframes AI as a five-layer cake—energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications—and dismisses doomer warnings as unscientific, urging acceleration over slowdown.
views.zh: 最近他把 AI 重新表述为五层蛋糕——能源、芯片、基础设施、模型、应用——并称末日论警告不科学，主张加速而非放缓。

people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼 CEO——ChatGPT 与 GPT-5 背后的实验室。前 Y Combinator 总裁；通往 AGI 竞赛中最核心、也最具争议的人物之一。

views.en: Minimize cognitive load, explore cheaply, then cut brutally; AGI will reduce the premium on human intelligence, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
views.zh: 2018 年他谈的是个人生产力：减少无关认知负荷、低成本探索后果断砍掉无效项；并预判 AGI 会降低人类智能的溢价，因此要在关系与为他人创造价值中寻找意义。

views.en: RLHF makes models usable with little data; deploy early so society adapts; alignment and capability are linked; compute becomes the most precious commodity.
views.zh: 2023 到 2024 年，他把重心转向 AI 本身：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用极少数据就让模型可用，主张尽早公开部署让社会适应，认为对齐与能力相互促进，并强调算力将成为最稀缺的商品。

views.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous scientific discovery; agentic AI is the key safety challenge; safety is built iteratively through deployment.
views.zh: 2025 年他明确 AGI（通用人工智能）是一个渐变而非单一里程碑，超级智能意味着自主科学发现；智能体式 AI 是最关键的安全挑战，安全必须通过迭代部署逐步构建，而非最后强加。

views.en: AGI is underdefined and may already be behind us; the real goal is a continuous ramp of superintelligence, with alignment and safety progressing alongside capabilities.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步说 AGI 定义不清、可能已被越过，真正的目标是超级智能的持续爬坡；对齐与安全必须与能力同步推进，甚至为此推迟前沿强化学习训练。

views.en: Iterative deployment, broad distribution of AI's benefits, and keeping humans in control recur throughout; he consistently rejects concentration of power and treats AI as a tool, not a creature.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线是：迭代部署、让 AI 收益广泛分布、确保人类保持控制；他一贯反对权力集中，并坚持 AI 是工具而非生物。

people.bioEn: Former CTO of OpenAI, where she led the development of ChatGPT, DALL·E and GPT-4. In 2025 she founded Thinking Machines Lab to build more understandable and customizable AI.
people.bioZh: 前 OpenAI CTO，主导了 ChatGPT、DALL·E 与 GPT-4 的研发。2025 年创办 Thinking Machines Lab，致力于构建更可理解、可定制的 AI。

views.en: Early on, Scaling and one large model were non-obvious bets; real-world deployment drives alignment and safety.
views.zh: 早期，Scaling（规模扩张）和专注单一大型模型并非显而易见的选择；真实世界部署推动对齐与安全。

views.en: AGI will transform every aspect of life; safety must be done in public with iterative deployment and feedback.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）将改变生活方方面面；安全必须在公开环境中通过迭代部署和反馈来完成。

views.en: From turn-based to interaction models: real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration as tools for thought.
views.zh: 从回合制转向交互模型：实时、高带宽的人机协作，作为思考工具。

views.en: Institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances matter more than individual character for alignment.
views.zh: 对于对齐，制度设计、透明度和制衡比个人品格更重要。

views.en: The future is not predestined; keep humans in the loop as long as possible for durable progress.
views.zh: 未来并非注定；尽可能长时间保持人类在环，以实现持久进步。

people.tiZh: DeepLearning.AI 创始人
people.bioEn: Co-founder of Google Brain and Coursera, and founder of DeepLearning.AI. One of the most influential educators in AI, and a measured voice on hype, agents, and how people should actually learn the field.
people.bioZh: Google Brain 与 Coursera 联合创始人，DeepLearning.AI 创始人。AI 领域最具影响力的教育者之一；对炒作、智能体，以及“普通人该如何学 AI”有冷静务实的看法。

views.en: Education as a human right; online courses with auto- and peer grading scale mastery learning and improve on-campus teaching.
views.zh: 2013 年，他把教育视为基本人权，主张用自动评分与同伴评分的大规模在线课程实现掌握式学习，并以翻转课堂反哺校内教育。

views.en: Scale drives deep learning; supervised learning beats unsupervised and RL hype; near-term AI issues matter more than AGI alignment.
views.zh: 2020 年，他强调 Scaling（规模扩张）是深度学习的关键，认为监督学习胜过被高估的无监督与强化学习，并主张近期的 AI 偏见等问题比 AGI（通用人工智能）对齐更紧迫。

views.en: Scaling still works but the recipe shifts to synthetic data and RL; agentic workflows, not smarter models alone, deliver real value.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 Scaling（规模扩张）仍有效，但配方转向合成数据与强化学习；真正创造价值的是智能体式工作流，而非单纯更聪明的模型。

views.en: Open-weight models prevent gatekeeper control and drive sovereign AI; export controls backfired, and China leads in open releases.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他一贯主张开放权重模型可防止守门人垄断、支撑主权 AI；并认为出口管制适得其反，中国在开放模型发布上领先。

views.en: AGI is a marketing term; no LLM alone is a path to it. AI augments rather than replaces jobs, so everyone should learn to code and use AI.
views.zh: 到 2026 年，他深化立场：AGI（通用人工智能）只是营销术语，单靠 LLM 无法通向它；AI 是增强而非取代工作，因此人人都该学编程并善用 AI。

people.tiZh: 阿尔伯塔大学教授
people.bioEn: The father of reinforcement learning and 2024 Turing Award laureate, author of "The Bitter Lesson". A pointed skeptic who argues today's LLMs are a dead end on the road to real intelligence.
people.bioZh: 强化学习之父，2024 年图灵奖得主，《苦涩的教训》作者。一位犀利的怀疑者——他认为当今的 LLM，是通往真正智能路上的一条死路。

views.en: Scaling is easy; the hard part is finding methods that scale. Backprop adjusts weights but does not solve representation learning.
views.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播只调整权重，并未解决表征学习，这是常见误解。

views.en: Intelligence needs a goal; next-token prediction is not a substantive goal. LLMs lack world models and only mimic text.
views.zh: 智能需要目标，下一个词预测不是实质目标；大语言模型没有世界模型，只是模仿文本，并非从经验中学习。

views.en: Reinforcement learning from experience is the basic paradigm; true learning is active trial and error, not passive imitation or supervised learning.
views.zh: 强化学习才是基本范式，真正的学习是主动试错，而非被动模仿或监督学习；RLHF 不是真正的从世界经验中学习。

views.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no design-time domain knowledge, learning open-ended abstractions from runtime experience via reward hypothesis.
views.zh: AGI（通用人工智能）需要无设计期领域知识的通用架构，通过奖励假设从运行时经验中学习开放式抽象，持续深度学习仍是未解前提。

views.en: The world is infinitely complex; continual learning from experience is essential, and synthetic data cannot replace it. The field is weird, not me.
views.zh: 世界无限复杂，必须持续从经验中学习，合成数据无法替代；当前 LLM 训练后即停止学习，语言只是智能的一小部分，是领域奇怪，不是我奇怪。

people.bioEn: Co-founder and President of OpenAI and its longtime technical backbone. Former CTO of Stripe, and a central builder behind GPT and OpenAI's push toward self-improving AI.
people.bioZh: OpenAI 联合创始人兼总裁，长期的技术中坚。前 Stripe CTO;GPT 与 OpenAI “自我改进 AI” 路线背后的核心建造者。

views.en: Scaling simple algorithms with massive compute can beat human performance; most AI progress is engineering, not new ML science.
views.zh: 2017 年他强调：用海量算力扩张简单算法就能超越人类表现，AI 进展多半是工程而非新的机器学习科学。

views.en: Scaling alone won't yield reasoning; chain of thought and learning human preferences from data are needed for alignment.
views.zh: 2019 年他提出：仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不会带来推理，需要思维链，并通过数据学习人类偏好来实现对齐。

views.en: Compute is the fundamental driver and now the biggest bottleneck; AGI is a continuous process, not a destination.
views.zh: 2025 年他转向：算力是根本驱动力，如今更成为最大瓶颈；AGI（通用人工智能）是持续过程而非终点。

views.en: Scaling laws continue unabated; post-training with reinforcement learning and compute supply, not architecture, are the real levers.
views.zh: 2026 年他深化：缩放定律持续有效，后训练与强化学习、以及算力供给——而非模型架构——才是真正的杠杆。

views.en: We are in the AGI era; the bottleneck shifts from building to sharing, with safety, security and alignment as first-class requirements.
views.zh: 2026 年他进一步主张：我们已身处 AGI 时代，瓶颈从构建转向共享，安全、安保与对齐必须成为一等要求。

people.tiZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO
people.bioEn: Co-founder and CEO of Mistral AI, Europe's leading open-weight model lab. A former DeepMind researcher and a prominent voice for open models and European AI sovereignty.
people.bioZh: Mistral AI 联合创始人兼 CEO——欧洲领先的开放权重模型实验室。前 DeepMind 研究员；开放模型与“欧洲 AI 主权”的代表性倡导者。

Mistral 7B: Changing the Game with Small Open Source AI Models

views.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: data quality and more tokens matter more than bigger models; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
views.zh: 2023 年，他指出缩放定律已被 Chinchilla 修正：数据质量和更多 token 比单纯做大模型更重要；开源能通过广泛审视促进安全。

views.en: Efficiency gains can reach 100x in three years; data quality is a bottleneck; value accrues at the application layer, not just foundation models.
views.zh: 2024 年，他进一步强调算法效率三年可提升 100 倍，数据质量是瓶颈；价值将沉淀在应用层，而非仅基础模型层。

views.en: AI should be embraced, not feared; sovereign AI requires control over data, infrastructure, and values; jobs are augmented, not replaced.
views.zh: 2025 年，他转向呼吁拥抱 AI 而非恐惧；主权 AI 需要掌控数据、基础设施与价值观；工作是被增强而非被取代。

views.en: Models are commoditizing; differentiation shifts to vertical specialization and customization; AGI as a single system will never exist; pre-training is saturating.
views.zh: 2026 年初，他判断模型正在商品化，差异化转向垂直专业化与定制化；作为单一系统的 AGI 永远不会存在；预训练正触及饱和墙。

views.en: Europe has a two-year window for independent AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption is bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence; AGI is a direction, not a destination.
views.zh: 2026 年中，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口建设独立 AI 基础设施；企业采用 AI 的瓶颈是组织变革而非模型智能；AGI 是方向而非终点。

people.tiZh: xAI 创始人
people.bioEn: Founder of xAI (Grok) and CEO of Tesla and SpaceX. A central and polarizing force in AI through xAI, Tesla's self-driving, and the Optimus robot, and an outspoken voice on AI risk.
people.bioZh: xAI（Grok）创始人，特斯拉与 SpaceX CEO。通过 xAI、特斯拉自动驾驶与 Optimus 机器人，他是 AI 领域核心而又极具争议的力量，也常就 AI 风险高调发声。

views.en: Full and rapid reusability is rocketry's holy grail; first principles and multiplanetary life are core.
views.zh: 2021 年他强调火箭完全快速可复用是降低入轨成本的圣杯，并以第一性原理和成为多行星物种作为根本目标。

views.en: AI safety needs truth-seeking, regulation, and third-party referees; lying AI is the real danger.
views.zh: 2023 至 2024 年，他把 AI 安全聚焦于坚持真理、监管与第三方裁判，认为让 AI 说谎才是最大风险。

views.en: Neuralink solves bandwidth and brain repair; human output under one bit per second limits AI symbiosis.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他提出 Neuralink 先修复脑损伤，再以高带宽脑机接口解决人类每秒不足一比特的通信瓶颈。

views.en: Intelligence big bang: digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next; Optimus is the greatest product.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他宣称正处智能大爆炸，数字超级智能可能今明两年到来，Optimus 将是史上最伟大产品。

views.en: AI compute hits Earth's power wall, pushing data centers to orbit; abundance makes money irrelevant.
views.zh: 2026 年，他判断 AI 算力将撞上地球电力墙，数据中心须转向太空，并预言丰裕时代使金钱不再重要。

people.tiZh: OpenAI 研究员
people.bioEn: A co-author of "Attention Is All You Need" (the Transformer paper) and co-creator of TensorFlow's Tensor2Tensor. Now at OpenAI, working on reasoning models.
people.bioZh: Transformer 奠基论文《Attention Is All You Need》的共同作者，TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor 的共同创造者。现于 OpenAI 研究推理模型。

episodes.tEn: Is Reasoning Enough for Generalization?
Why AI Progress Isn't Slowing Down

views.en: Pre-training Scaling laws still hold; reasoning models with chain of thought and reinforcement learning yield more gains per compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他仍坚持预训练缩放定律有效，但强调思维链与强化学习驱动的推理模型能在单位算力下带来更大提升。

views.en: Economic pressure pushes smaller, cheaper models; distillation and economics, not technical limits, slowed pre-training Scaling.
views.zh: 2025 年，他指出经济压力推动更小更便宜的模型，是蒸馏与经济因素而非技术极限拖慢了预训练 Scaling。

views.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive recent gains; multimodal lags, processing inputs sequentially like tiny patches.
views.zh: 从 2025 到 2026 年，他持续认为后训练改进（如强化学习与合成数据）驱动近期进展，而多模态仍落后，像小块一样顺序处理输入。

views.en: Reasoning with RL and tools solves hard problems but needs vast data; generalization remains key, models learn concepts only after exhausting surface patterns.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化观点：推理结合强化学习与工具能解决难题但仍需海量数据；泛化仍是关键，模型只在穷尽表面模式后才学会概念。

views.en: Coding agents boost productivity 5-10x; near-term risks like system hacking matter more than existential risk.
views.zh: 2026 年，他转向智能体式实践：编码智能体提升生产力 5-10 倍；系统入侵等近期风险比存在性风险更紧迫。

people.tiZh: CMU 教授 · OpenAI 董事
people.bioEn: A Carnegie Mellon professor and head of its machine learning department, and a member of OpenAI's board. Known for work on adversarial robustness and deep learning theory.
people.bioZh: 卡内基梅隆大学教授、机器学习系主任，OpenAI 董事会成员。以对抗鲁棒性与深度学习理论的研究著称。

episodes.tEn: AI Red Teaming Outperforms Humans
AI Safety Oversight at OpenAI: A Conversation with Ziko Culture
AI Data Crisis: Myth or Reality?
Machine Learning Algorithms, Unsupervised Learning, and Probability

views.en: ML fundamentals: hypothesis classes, loss functions, optimization; evaluation via train/validation/test splits; neural nets succeed despite no optimality guarantee.
views.zh: 2014 年，他聚焦机器学习基础：假设类、损失函数与优化方法；强调用训练/验证/测试集划分来评估以避免过拟合；并指出神经网络虽无最优参数保证却取得重大成功。

views.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; larger models still improve on fixed data; safety means reliable specification-following.
views.zh: 2024 年，他提出下一个词预测能产生智能系统，是一大科学发现；数据短缺并非迫在眉睫，多模态数据远未充分利用；更大模型在固定数据集上仍持续提升；AI 安全当前最大问题是模型无法可靠遵循规范。

views.en: Safety requires explicit training and layered defenses, not just Scaling; agent security introduces prompt injection; RL enables self-improvement; interpretability may succeed via AI agents.
views.zh: 2026 年，他深化安全观：安全需要显式训练与多层防御，而非仅靠 Scaling；智能体安全引入提示注入等新漏洞；强化学习让模型基于自身输出自我改进；可解释性可能通过 AI 智能体自动化研究而成功。

views.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming outperforms humans; capability does not correlate with robustness; prompt injection lethal trifecta; enterprise needs configurable security.
views.zh: 2026 年，他进一步指出 AI 具有异于传统软件的漏洞，需新安全思维；自动化红队已能超越人类红队；模型能力与鲁棒性不相关；提示注入的致命三要素需同时满足；企业需要可配置、持续开发的安全模型。

views.en: Architecture matters little; data and Scaling drive progress; safety requires explicit effort beyond Scaling; nuanced views reject accelerationist/doomer labels.
views.zh: 贯穿始终的主线：架构本身影响有限，数据与 Scaling 才是进步驱动力；安全需要超越 Scaling 的显式努力；他拒绝加速主义与末日论的简单标签，坚持 nuanced 立场。

people.tiZh: Anthropic 研究员
people.bioEn: A researcher at Anthropic focused on scaling and reinforcement learning, and a prominent young voice on how far today's models can really go.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 研究员，专注于规模扩张与强化学习；关于「当前模型究竟能走多远」的代表性青年声音。

episodes.tEn: Anthropic's Super Bowl Ads: A Blue Shell Attack on OpenAI?
The AI Compute Super Cycle and the Making of Claude Sonnet 4.5
RL and Language Models: Progress, Agents, and Feedback Loops in 2025
Douglas on Claude 4: Coding, Agents, and the Future of AI
Long Context: The Underhyped Key to Superhuman AI

views.en: Long context is underhyped; it solves onboarding and boosts intelligence, while agents lag on reliability, not long-horizon ability.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为长上下文窗口被低估：它解决“上手”问题并大幅提升智能；智能体没起飞主因是可靠性，而非长程任务能力。

views.en: RL on language models has no complexity ceiling; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as the leading indicator.
views.zh: 2025 年，他主张语言模型上的强化学习没有智力复杂度上限；预训练加强化学习或许足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能），而编程是进展的领先指标。

views.en: Verifiable-reward RL is the key breakthrough; models learn new skills, not just elicit pre-trained knowledge, as AlphaGo showed.
views.zh: 2025 年，他强调可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破；模型能学到新能力而非仅调用预训练知识，正如 AlphaGo 所示。

views.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands what models can do, and Transformers suffice for AGI.
views.zh: 2025 年，他把强化学习视为新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴；更长的智能体式连贯性拓展了模型能力，且 Transformer 足以通向 AGI（通用人工智能）。

views.en: Capability overhang means orchestration beats raw intelligence; compute is the bottleneck, and world models are off the AGI critical path.
views.zh: 2026 年，他认为能力过剩意味着编排比原始智能更重要；算力是瓶颈，而世界模型不在 AGI（通用人工智能）的关键路径上。

people.tiZh: Ai2 研究科学家
people.bioEn: A research scientist at the Allen Institute for AI (Ai2) working on RLHF and open models (OLMo), and author of the widely-read Interconnects newsletter.
people.bioZh: 艾伦人工智能研究所（Ai2）研究科学家，从事 RLHF 与开放模型（OLMo）;广受关注的 Interconnects 通讯作者。

views.en: RLHF persists as the dominant fine-tuning method; safety is a system-level property, and fine-tuning can undo alignment with minimal compute.
views.zh: 2024 年，他认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）仍是最主流的微调技术并将持续，安全是系统级属性而非模型本身；微调只需极少算力就能破坏对齐，但这并不意外。

views.en: Post-training splits into SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards; data quality beats algorithm choice, and open recipes can match frontier models.
views.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他把后训练拆解为 SFT、DPO 与带可验证奖励的强化学习三阶段，强调数据质量远胜算法选择，开源后训练配方足以逼近前沿模型。

views.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, but overoptimization and inference-scaling plots are traps; better verifiers matter more than parallel compute.
views.zh: 2025 年，他视 RLVR 为后训练最大突破，同时警告过度优化与推理时扩展曲线是假象，更好的验证器比并行算力更重要。

views.en: Open models need full transparency—data, checkpoints, recipes—and Chinese labs like Qwen and DeepSeek now drive openness as US open-source lags.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张开源 AI 需要数据、中间检查点与配方的完全透明，并指出 Qwen、DeepSeek 等中国实验室正主导开放，而美国开源出现真空。

views.en: Scaling laws still hold for pre-training but low-hanging fruit is gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling, with open models 6-9 months behind.
views.zh: 2026 年，他坚持缩放定律在预训练仍成立但红利已尽，增益转向后训练与推理扩展；开源模型落后闭源前沿 6 至 9 个月，且差距可能扩大。

people.tiZh: Scale AI 创始人 · Meta 超智能
people.bioEn: Founder and former CEO of Scale AI, which built much of the data infrastructure behind modern AI. In 2025 he joined Meta to lead its Superintelligence Labs.
people.bioZh: Scale AI 创始人兼前 CEO——它构建了现代 AI 背后的大量数据基础设施。2025 年加入 Meta，领导其超级智能实验室。

views.en: AGI is far off; data, not compute alone, is the bottleneck; boring AI applications will drive huge economic impact.
views.zh: 2019 年他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）还很遥远，仅靠无限算力无法产生通用智能；数据而非算力才是机器学习的核心瓶颈，表单处理、放射科等“无聊”的 AI 应用将带来巨大经济价值。

views.en: Data is the new code, not oil; the next 2-3 years define decades; the limiting factor for Scaling is data and expert availability for post-training.
views.zh: 2023 年他把数据称为“新代码”而非“新石油”，强调未来 2-3 年将定义此后数十年；Scaling（规模扩张）的最大限制不是算力，而是数据与后训练所需的人类专家供给，企业应用专有数据微调基础模型。

views.en: Data remains the bottleneck; post-training with specialized data improves frontier models; the biggest blocker for agentic AI is product design, not model capability.
views.zh: 2024 年他延续数据瓶颈论，指出用专门数据做后训练是提升前沿模型的关键；并首次提出智能体式 AI 的最大障碍是产品设计而非模型能力，同时否认中美实验室存在研究差距。

views.en: Scaling laws hold; AI enters recursive self-improvement; agents finally work; data is strategic like oil; AI centralizes rather than democratizes.
views.zh: 2025 至 2026 年他转向乐观的加速论：缩放定律依然成立，AI 进入递归自我改进的新范式，智能体终于真正可用；数据成为国家战略资产，AI 是集中化而非民主化的技术。

views.en: Superintelligence is near; scale compute, data, RL across axes; open-sourcing powerful models is unsafe; personal superintelligence for billions via agents.
views.zh: 到 2026 年他进一步深化为超级智能临近论：需在多轴向上扩展算力、数据与强化学习；开源强大模型不安全，Meta 转向选择性发布，目标是为数十亿人构建个人超级智能，并主张模型福利。

people.tiZh: Claude Code 创造者 · Anthropic
people.bioEn: Creator and lead of Claude Code, Anthropic's agentic command-line coding tool, and a central figure in the shift to AI-driven software engineering.
people.bioZh: Anthropic 智能体命令行编程工具 Claude Code 的创造者与负责人；AI 驱动软件工程浪潮中的核心人物。
